@@U01936@@
What, dragged off so far already? I guess I'll have to show them who’s master here. Make way! Squire Nick is coming through! Make way there, make way, good people! —Here, Doctor, hold on tight! One grand leap and we're free of this mob that’s too wild even for me.
translation:
@@U01936@@
怎么，已经拖这么远了？我想我得让他们看看谁才是这里的主人。让路！乡绅尼克来了！让路，让路，好人们！ ——来了，博士，抓紧了！一次巨大的飞跃，我们就摆脱了这群即使对我来说也太狂野的暴徒。
